description: Identify an African bank from any identifier you hold: its name, domestic sort/bank code, SWIFT/BIC code, or USSD shortcode. Works as a reverse lookup, so pass a bare SWIFT code like 'NLCBTZTX' to find out which institution it belongs to. Returns the bank's name, country, type, bank code, SWIFT/BIC, USSD shortcode and whether it supports mobile money.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country code to scope the search (e.g. NG, GH, KE, ZA, TZ).

query.description: Bank name, bank/sort code, SWIFT/BIC code, or USSD shortcode.

name: lookup_bank
title: Look up an African bank by name or code
